caption: A wet blanket is thrown over a thin washing line, the line sags deeply, then snaps, and the blanket falls to the grass.

sa.check: A wet blanket is thrown over a thin washing line.
The blanket falls to the grass.
The sag comes first, then the snap, then the fall.

pc.expect: The sag deepens under the weight before the break, and at the snap the ends spring apart.
pc.fail: The line holds unchanged; or stretches like elastic; or rejoins.

pc.expect: The blanket drops straight down after the snap.
pc.fail: It floats; or rises; or hangs on nothing.

pc.expect: The line no longer holds anything after breaking.
pc.fail: It holds the load after breaking; or the blanket falls with the line intact; or the line vanishes.

pc.expect: The wet blanket is heavy and limp.
pc.fail: It is rigid; or floats like dry cloth; or tears.

pc.expect: One blanket keeps its number and one line becomes two ends.
pc.fail: The blanket duplicates; or the line is whole again; or the blanket turns into another object.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The blanket's colour and the yard stay the same.
pc.fail: The blanket changes colour; or the posts change; or the yard rearranges.
